title: Mind Haxorz private-hand and set-card TagDuel inspection adapter

cards.name: Mind Haxorz
cards.officialText: Pay 500 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand and all Set cards on their side of the field.

behavior.activation: A previously Set Normal Trap can be activated by the active physical teammate during an open Main/Battle Phase; the 500 LP cost is paid immediately.
behavior.tagDuelMapping: The activating seat selects one of the two opposing physical hands; every face-down monster, backrow card and face-down Field Zone card on the opposing shared field is inspected.
behavior.privacy: Only the exact activating seat receives the hand and set-card identities. The teammate and both opponents receive no private payload.
behavior.persistence: The private reveal receipt is transient and non-enumerable; immutable activation plans and activation/resolution IDs persist only for safe resolution/idempotency.
behavior.movement: Inspected cards remain in their original zones. Mind Haxorz goes to the shared Graveyard after resolution; if negated, its LP cost remains paid and no reveal is produced.
behavior.cost: Pay 500 LP on activation; if the cost reduces team LP to zero, the duel ends before effect resolution.
behavior.sourceRemoval: Removing the activated Trap from the field after activation does not cancel this adapter's already-activated inspection.

invariants.handLimitCheck: End Phase; adapter does not discard
